candidates.change_summary: Require msg.value to be 2 ether instead of 1 ether, changing whether lockInGuess accepts the call and thus the stored guess state.
Remove the check that previous guess.block is zero, allowing overwriting an existing guess and changing stored state after call.
Set guesses[msg.sender].block to block.number (instead of block.number + 1), altering the recorded lock block observable after call.
Store a different value for guess by inverting the provided hash (XOR with bytes32(0xff...)), changing the stored guess observable after the call.

Insert resetting guesses[msg.sender].guess to zero before storing the new hash, ensuring a different visible value momentarily and guaranteeing the stored guess becomes the provided hash only after reset (order change could matter to observers reading state mid-transaction via reentrancy).
Replace the line that sets guesses[msg.sender].block to 0 with setting it to the current block number, so settle leaves a nonzero block value after execution.
Replace the line that sets guesses[msg.sender].block to 0 with deleting that line (i.e., no reset), so the stored block remains unchanged after settle.
Replace the zero-reset assignment with setting block to guesses[msg.sender].block + 1, changing the stored block value after settle.
Replace the zero-reset assignment with setting block to guesses[msg.sender].block - 1, which makes settle leave a different (possibly zero) value.
Replace the zero-reset assignment with setting block to a constant nonzero value (1), altering the stored block after settle.
